description: A subtle N–S oriented low‐relief embankment flanked by parallel concavities, approximately 650 m long, running beneath closed canopy. Visible as a faint linear ridge in hillshade composites (panels 2–4) and coincident with a narrow band of reduced NIR reflectance (indicative of wetter, darker earth) in the central portion of the tile. The feature lies entirely outside of any OSM‐mapped roads or clearings.

An E–W oriented pair of low mounded banks with an intervening shallow channel, about 400 m in total length. Detected as rectilinear curvature anomalies in the DTM (elevations vary by <1 m across the structure), with corresponding vegetation stress in the true‐color overlay and slightly elevated moisture signature (darker tone) in the NIR band. Lies ~350 m south of anomaly_1 and is not coincident with any OSM features.
